_note: Street, ownership, events, regulation, critiques, gaps and conflicts as of 30-Sep-2026. Broker notes after 30-Sep-2026 (Q2FY27 updates of 16-19 Oct) are excluded (see updates/later-facts.json).

street._method: Brokers that disclose a method value LTF on P/B on FY28E (Mar-28E) book: Motilal Oswal, Emkay, ICICI Securities and ICICI Direct all at 2.7x. UBS (23-Sep-2026) uses 18x FY28E EPS.

brokers.thesis: Lakshya 2031 execution on an AI-led platform; ~25% loan and ~30% PAT CAGR FY26-28E; ROA 2.6% and ROE ~15% in FY28E; further re-rating as ROA rises
~23% AUM CAGR FY26-28E; NIM+fees resilient at 10.47%; credit cost to 2-2.2%; ROA ~2.4% FY27-28E
Strong start to FY27; >20% AUM growth, NIM+fees 10-10.5%, credit cost to ~2-2.2% by FY27 exit; ROA ~2.8% near term and >3% medium term
Q1 beat; EPS +2%/+4% FY27/28E; earnings and AUM ~24% CAGR FY26-28E
Q1 profit 8% above estimates; asset quality encouraging (AI underwriting in 2W); risks: monsoon and insurance-distribution reforms
₹23,800 cr retail disbursements; urban finance +57%; retail AUM +6.6% QoQ
PPoP and PAT beat but NIM pressure and net slippages up 17bp QoQ to 2.14%; at ~2.3x FY28 book, limited room to re-rate
Stronger unsecured credit cycle (personal loans ~30% growth for NBFCs); LTF a beneficiary; target assumes higher EPS and a higher multiple
28% loan growth will not fix returns soon; ROE 15% is 2.5-3 years away (secondary sources only)

estimates._note: Broker estimates standing on 30-Sep-2026 (consolidated). None of these notes priced IRDAI's 23-Sep-2026 proposal.

consensus.source: GAM arithmetic on the nine targets above (no dated consensus EPS available to us)

events.title: ~₹3,000 cr rights issue (FY21)
events.detail: 46.13 cr shares issued; ₹3,005 cr raised in FY21 incl. ESOPs. Equity capital rose from ₹2,005 cr to ₹2,469 cr.
events.src: Annual Report FY22 (share-capital reconciliation; cash-flow statement)

events.title: Lakshya 2026 launched
events.detail: Goals: retailisation >95%, retail book CAGR >25%, GS3 <3%, NS3 <1%, ROA 2.8-3.0% by FY26.

events.title: Mutual fund business sold to HSBC Asset Management
events.detail: Gain of ₹2,575 cr on the L&T Investment Management divestment (plus ₹283 cr on a capital reduction), in FY23 discontinued operations.

events.title: Accelerated sell-down of the wholesale book
events.detail: One-time fair-valuation loss of ₹2,687 cr on reclassifying the wholesale loan book (FY23 exceptional); continuing operations lost ₹729 cr after tax; wholesale book fell from ₹43,257 cr (FY22) to ₹19,840 cr, much of it sold to ARCs for security receipts.
events.src: Annual Report FY24, P&L and note 47; Q4FY24 presentation p41

events.title: Lending subsidiaries merged into the listed company
events.detail: L&T Finance, L&T Infra Credit and L&T Mutual Fund Trustee merged into L&T Finance Holdings (appointed date 1-Apr-2023), renamed L&T Finance Ltd (RBI certificate 29-Apr-2024).
events.src: Annual Report FY24, share-capital note and note 55; Q1FY27 presentation p3

events.title: Sudipta Roy becomes MD & CEO
events.detail: Succeeded Dinanath Dubhashi; ex-ICICI Bank, Citibank, Deutsche Bank.
events.src: Annual Report FY26 (directors' details); Annual Report FY24 chairman's letter

events.title: Microfinance stress (FY25)
events.detail: Over-leveraged borrowers, Karnataka/Tamil Nadu disruption: RBF PAR 1-30 rose to 1.1%; credit cost 3.80% in Q4FY25 before ₹300 cr of macro-prudential releases; ₹850 cr released over Q3FY25-Q2FY26.
events.src: Q1FY27 presentation p34, p46; Q4FY25 call

events.title: Gold loan business of Paul Merchants Finance acquired
events.detail: Slump sale: ₹1,335 cr book, 130 branches, 696 staff for ₹712 cr cash (goodwill ₹182 cr). 343 gold branches by Jun-2026; book ₹3,829 cr.
events.src: Annual Report FY26, note 46; Q1FY27 presentation p25

events.title: Lakshya 2031 unveiled; payments platform approved
events.detail: 20%+ book CAGR, credit cost <2%, ROA 3.0-3.2%, ROE 16-18%; Lakshya 2026 ROA goal (2.8-3.0%) missed (2.40% in Q4FY26).
events.src: Q4FY26 presentation p5, p10; Q4FY26 call

events.title: Q1FY27: record PAT ₹902 cr (+29%), book +27%
events.detail: Credit cost 2.54%, ROA 2.48%, ROE 12.71%; ₹1,000-1,200 cr of disbursements turned away; 500 gold branches planned for FY27.

events.title: IRDAI consultation paper on insurance distribution
events.detail: Per IIFL's summary: credit-life commission capped at 2% (28% now), nil on loan-packaged motor TP (16%), 5% on health (40%), compulsory bundling banned, curbs on staff incentives; comments by 25-Oct-2026. LTF fell as much as 9.99% to ₹279.65 on 24-Sep; IIFL put LTF's PBT hit at 12% (with 50% mitigation), the highest among NBFCs.

market.detail: September 2026 sell-off: Nifty and Sensex down ~5% for the month by 28-Sep on foreign selling, Brent ~$106 and US 10-year yields at 5.2%; a majority of economists polled expected a 25bp repo hike at the next RBI meeting. LTF fell from ₹312.8 (18-Sep weekly close) to ₹265.00 on 30-Sep (−15%), most of it after the IRDAI paper.

regulatory.upperLayer: NBFC-Upper Layer under RBI scale-based regulation: CRAR ≥15%, Tier 1 ≥10%.
regulatory.mfi: MFIN guardrails (max three lenders incl. LTF, ₹2 lakh total JLG indebtedness); LTF applies stricter in-house norms (0 DPD applicants only). Industry book deleveraged from ~₹4.4 lakh cr peak to ~₹3.3 lakh cr (CEO, 13-Jul-2026). CGFMU cover taken on 35-40% of FY27 microfinance disbursements.
regulatory.gold: RBI's new gold-loan rules (in force from Apr-2026; tiered loan-to-value and need assessment) cut April originations industry-wide (CEO).
regulatory.insurance: IRDAI consultation (23-Sep-2026): see events. LTF distribution income ₹1,047 cr in FY26 (~26% of PBT); life (mostly credit life) ₹880 cr.

ownership.note: L&T held 165.25 cr shares (65.99%) at Mar-26; its share drifts down as ESOP shares are issued. Domestic institutions rose from 8.7% (Mar-24) to 14.9%; foreign investors from 5.5% (Mar-25) to 7.7%. Named holders above 1% were not available to us (gap).
ownership.src: Screener.in shareholding (BSE pattern); Annual Report FY26 shareholding note

critiques: ROE of 15% is 2.5-3 years away; loan growth alone will not fix returns
Valuation already discounts the good news at ~2.3x FY28 book; NIM pressure and rising slippages
Insurance distribution income is at regulatory risk; LTF the most exposed NBFC (12% of PBT even after mitigation)
IIFL (24-Sep-2026); Nomura and Emkay risk lists
Personal-loan growth (+80% book) through digital partners is unseasoned
Analysts on the Q1 call; UBS flags untested unsecured books
Monsoon / El Niño risk to microfinance and tractors
Core NIM fell 24bp QoQ as leverage rose
gaps: Split of the ₹880 cr life-insurance distribution income between credit life sold with microfinance and other loans; our IRDAI haircut (a third of distribution income from FY28E, net of mitigation) is a GAM estimate.
Segment yields, credit costs and profit by business (the company does not disclose segment P&Ls); the AUM build is illustrative.
Gold-loan yield, loss rate and profitability; gold AUM targets beyond branch plans.
Valuation methods of Nomura, Citi, JPMorgan and Morgan Stanley; the Morgan Stanley and Citi notes are from secondary sources only; no dated consensus EPS/BVPS.
Quarterly split of revenue into interest and fees on the annual-report basis.
Named institutional holders above 1% and their stakes (Jun-2026).
Retail vs wholesale book before FY19; provisions and fee split before FY21.
Resolution timeline and expected recovery on the ₹4,808 cr net security receipts (management: 'three to four years').
conflicts: Interest income: annual report ₹16,616 cr vs company presentation ₹15,948 cr (FY26); the company moves ~₹670 cr of treasury and other income into 'fee & other income' (₹1,973 cr vs ₹1,298 cr in the accounts). NIM+fees are unaffected.
Credit cost: impairment + write-offs ₹2,746 cr (accounts) vs ₹2,751 cr (presentation) in FY26; FY25 ₹2,468 cr vs ₹2,311 cr after ₹400 cr of macro-prudential releases.
Screener FY24 revenue ₹14,252 cr and expenses ₹6,195 cr vs audited ₹13,577 cr and ₹5,530 cr (same ~₹675 cr in both); we use the audited figures (LTF.patch.js).
Q1FY27 profit: company ₹902 cr; Screener ₹916 cr before its minority line (Screener EPS ₹3.60 = ₹902 cr).
Book value per share: Q1FY27 ₹112.6 after the ₹2.75 dividend paid in the quarter; FY26 ₹111.7.
ICICI Securities' institutional desk (₹370, 12-Jul) and its retail arm ICICI Direct (₹380, 13-Jul) both use ~2.7x FY28E book.
